A hostile saw you: time now only moves when you act. Thinking is free — read the timeline on the right before acting.
A “!” and red tiles: an attack is engaged and resolves when its counter comes up. Move, guard (G) or strike first.
A hit sets a chain segment (the dots below you). Chain five elements in generation order — or four quick hits then a heavy one — to resolve.
Combat releases: the end screen shows the duration in ticks and the XP of each track (element, weapon, damage type, armour).
